architecture.base_component_rule: for each asset, base_component=min(actual accepted economic weight, current frozen cap=1 base target)
architecture.cross_margin_equity_for_liquidation_mode: 0.25 * reference_equity; spot is neither perp notional nor additional cross-margin collateral
architecture.incremental_overlay_rule: actual accepted economic weight above the base component is perp-only
architecture.name: SPOT_FIRST_BASE_PLUS_PERP_OVERLAY_V1
architecture.route_reconstruction_rule: spot + base_perp + incremental_perp must exactly reconstruct accepted economic weight per asset
architecture.spot_allocation_rule: BTC/ETH/SOL base components are allocated to spot proportionally up to aggregate 0.75 NAV; any residual base component is perp

broad_region_and_selection.near_tie: within the same contiguous passing component, any caps within 1.0 percentage point CAGR of the best are tied and the lower cap is selected
broad_region_and_selection.primary: highest 5bps architecture CAGR among qualifying caps
broad_region_and_selection.prospective_p4_6_cap: next lower preregistered grid point than selected research cap, capped at 1.20
broad_region_and_selection.qualifying_cap: an interior >1 cap whose immediate lower, self, and immediate higher caps all pass every pre-broad hard gate

candidate_gate.after_cost_10bps: terminal wealth strictly greater than both LEVERAGE-0041 cap1 and legacy BRRK
candidate_gate.after_cost_5bps: terminal wealth strictly greater than both LEVERAGE-0041 cap1 and legacy BRRK
candidate_gate.not_dominated_20bps: not Pareto dominated on terminal wealth and max drawdown by either comparator

execution_cost_and_capacity.reference_trade_notional: absolute route-weight change * 2000 USD reference equity

funding_economics.base_perp_pre_native_caveat: pre-native full-history architecture metrics do not invent missing Hyperliquid base-perp funding; the separate native common-window funding gate is mandatory for promotion
funding_economics.binance_proxy: report-only stress proxy, never a Hyperliquid level estimate
funding_economics.complete_day_rule: exactly three 8h blocks are required for a session to be complete
funding_economics.full_path_rule: charge native funding only on sessions with complete native evidence; before native evidence exists do not synthesize a Hyperliquid level from Binance; missing history therefore keeps incremental overlay at zero until a complete seven-session native lookback exists
funding_economics.funding_gate: for every 1x/2x/3x/5x native scenario, candidate common-window terminal wealth must be >= LEVERAGE-0041 cap1 comparator, max drawdown must remain above -70%, and every native session must have complete evidence
funding_economics.spike_rule: magnify long funding debits only; favorable credits are not enlarged

funding_reducer.causality: today's overlay scale uses prior completed sessions only; current-session funding cannot alter the same-session target
funding_reducer.linear_rule: scale=1 at <=5; scale=(10-debit)/5 for 5<debit<10; scale=0 at >=10
funding_reducer.lookback_interpretation: seven completed prior daily sessions = 168 hours
funding_reducer.metric: sum(non-negative realized native funding debit returns over seven prior sessions) / average routed perp gross over those sessions / 7 * 10000 bps/day
funding_reducer.rebalance_semantics: the reducer changes the requested target but does not bypass the frozen P3.3 L1 rebalance band
funding_reducer.target_rule: effective_target = frozen cap1 base + overlay_scale * (requested_target - frozen cap1 base)

immutable_prior_result.role: motivation/comparator only; no retuning or reinterpretation

liquidation.notional_rule: actual routed total perp weight per asset * 2000 USD reference equity
liquidation.spot_treatment: excluded from perp notional and excluded from the explicit 25% cross-margin collateral
liquidation.starting_liquidatable_state: distance=0 and FAIL, not an exception escape
liquidation.synthetic_gap_rule: evaluate actual routed perp notionals against the same fixed explicit cross-margin reserve with no same-day transfer/rebalance

one_time_boundary.recovery_rule: only a separately audited non-economic implementation correction may recover a failed run; no economic parameter, threshold, cap, funding rule, route architecture, seed, stress, gate or selection rule may change after first candidate computation

owner_authorization_scope: preregistration merge, implementation, pre-run validation, and the single LEVERAGE-0041 RUN_ONCE are authorized; P4.6 production authorization remains separate

risk_and_robustness.bootstrap_gate: terminal outperformance probability >=0.80 and annualized return-difference p05 >= -1pp versus both LEVERAGE-0041 cap1 and legacy BRRK for each block size
risk_and_robustness.start_date_gate: candidate CAGR may not underperform either comparator by more than 2pp at any preregistered start

session_timing.simulator_input_rule: include evaluation_start - 1 day as the first decision observation so the first emitted return is exactly the evaluation start session

target_authority.cap_1_rule: requested target at cap 1.00 must equal the rebuilt frozen raw BRRK-0011 target byte/numerically exactly within 1e-12
target_authority.interpretation: the frozen BRRK target already contains the defensive scale; multiplying by cap preserves the defensive state and relative asset weights while cap=1 remains exact
target_authority.source: the same corrected raw-target authority used by LEVERAGE-0040 R1-R5
